toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Look up known CVE vulnerabilities for an npm package+version or a specific CVE ID. Returns CVSS scores, descriptions, and fix versions from NVD and OSV. Results are cached for 10 minutes. Costs $0.01 USDC per call.

toolsPreview.name: reputation_check
toolsPreview.description: Check the reputation of an IP address or domain using AbuseIPDB and VirusTotal. Returns a security verdict (malicious/suspicious/unknown/clean) with confidence signals. Verdict is conservative: incomplete data returns 'unknown' never 'clean'. Results are cached for 10 minutes. Costs $0.01 USDC per call.

toolsPreview.name: secret_scan
toolsPreview.description:
Scan text content for hardcoded secrets, API keys, and credentials using 20 pre-compiled patterns.

Privacy guarantee: Input text is NEVER logged, cached, stored, or forwarded.
Only findings_count and finding offsets (not matched values) are returned.

Detected pattern types include: AWS keys, GitHub/GitLab PATs, OpenAI/Anthropic keys,
Stripe secrets, Slack tokens, PEM private keys, JWT tokens, and 13 more.

Per-call rate limit: 100/min. Payment: $0.05 USDC per scan.
